items.title: Google introduced Gemini 4 Carbon
items.oneliner: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon tops Artificial Analysis. Security-first coding models are becoming the default enterprise buy.

items.title: Nvidia released an open multilingual ASR model
items.oneliner: Nvidia shipped open ASR for 40 languages with speaker attribution. Voice stacks just got cheaper to own.

items.title: Tax agents failed real professional work
items.oneliner: On 50 tax assignments, top agents passed under 11%. Domain automation is still nowhere near staff replacement.

items.title: A UEFI flaw threatens most servers
items.oneliner: A CVSS 9.5 bug in TianoCore EDK II hits pre-boot trust. Firmware remains the industry's ugliest patching problem.

items.title: Tailscale is patching SSH privilege escalation
items.oneliner: Tailscale confirmed SSH privilege escalation issues and urged policy tightening now. Zero-trust products still fail at privilege boundaries.

items.title: Apple still trusts compromised certificates
items.oneliner: Apple's git, curl, and python3 still trust compromised eMudhra certs. Supply-chain risk now ships with the developer workstation.

items.title: Most SVG sanitizers were bypassed
items.oneliner: PortSwigger bypassed six of eight SVG sanitizers. If your app accepts SVG uploads, assume your filter is theater.

items.title: LLM bug hunting beat classic fuzzing
items.oneliner: Google found 45 V8 bugs with BigSleep versus 37 with Fuzzilli. AI security tooling is now additive, not optional.

items.title: A robot PCB factory went live
items.oneliner: CircuitHub's Grid promises four-day custom PCB builds without manual changeovers. Hardware iteration is starting to look like software.

items.title: Oracle will bring Google TPUs to OCI
items.oneliner: Oracle will add Google TPUs to OCI in 2027. Cloud AI infrastructure is consolidating around whoever can secure chips.
